_comment: PLAN P3's gate list as data, plus the gates this project built outside that list.
`p3_gate.py` keeps the two ends together: a covered entry must name a file that exists and
that ci.sh runs, a deferred entry must say why and what would make it buildable, and every
gate file in this directory must be named. There is no entry without a decision.
`plan_targets` repeats the plan's own list so deleting an entry cannot silently shrink it.

entries.why: accuracy is a property of the quantisation pipeline, and there is no pipeline to measure yet (PLAN P5.4)
entries.trigger: when PTQ produces blobs, accuracy gates end-to-end top-1 against the float reference

entries.why: no RAM budget table exists (PLAN P4.4); the only memory evidence today is the workspace-bounds contract tests
entries.trigger: when the per-target memory table lands, the gate reconciles it with the arena sizes the tests use

entries.what: the C/C++ standard and CMake minimum the metadata declares are the ones CMakeLists.txt sets
workflows do not dump the secret context, pin their actions, and never follow a moving branch
every claim in claim-basis.json has a reachable basis commit, a real gate and live counts
the standards ledger is complete and its `have` pointers resolve; the patent ledger stays empty and invents no numbers
conandata.yml <-> metadata.json four buckets <-> baremetal_white_list <-> attribution

entries.why: the doc system has not started (PLAN P5); the three layers it would compare are still the template's
entries.trigger: when sphinx/README content is ours, the gate refuses a sentence that appears in two layers

entries.what: @param names match the declaration's parameters; no revision-log table in a file header
a local-only conclusion must carry commit/host/date and a reproduce line, and the commit must be an ancestor of HEAD
every cited G-<n> exists in the local ledger; skip with a reason when the ledger is absent
the grad column is a decision: no-grad needs a reason, done needs a named test; the numeric finite-difference check belongs to P6
the licence this project declares is one we accept, and the LICENSE text is the one it names

entries.why: there is no reference pipeline to compare against: no blob importer, no reference interpreter (PLAN P5.3/P5.4)
entries.trigger: when the blob format and the Python reference writer exist, oracle compares them against onnxruntime on a fixed corpus

entries.what: every non-scalar done cell has a scalar reference for the same (name, dtype, quant)

entries.why: the board admission matrix is not in this tree (supportable-board-matrix.yml belongs to the platform work), so there is no list to admit into
entries.trigger: when a target list lands, the gate admits only targets that build with a house toolchain and pass KAT

entries.what: with the vendor option off, the object defines none of the backend's symbols; with it on, it defines them (V2), so V1 cannot pass because the branch is empty
every infr_* declaration is reachable from C and C++ under the same name
matrix <-> census <-> test ids, plus the grad and scalar-reference rules
the coverage floors, computed from counts rather than reported rates
docstring contract on include/ + src/ (D1-D8)
no development-domain vocabulary (INV-n / Pn.n / plan wording) in the shipped surface
installed headers stay C99-pedantic includable
public structs are initialised with field names
two measured claims about what the compiler vectorises and what the hand-written tiers use
this inventory: every gate is built and wired, or deferred with a why and a trigger
process documents cannot be published, and stay renderable
the matrix's third list: register.c rows must match the done cells
INV-11's root allowlist, in both directions
ASan + UBSan over the runtime and kernel boundaries
the template contract: pinned bytes, declared forks, pinned template prose
what lives where: layer and directory scope rules
house vs third-party toolchains, and what CI cannot run (T1-T6)
